purpose: Reject cliché substrings inside longer words, allow one deliberate transition per paragraph, and retain true positives for RULE-05 and RULE-D. The two boundary classes are deliberately different and both are pinned here: RULE-05 stops at a word character only, so `a novelty-detection` stays suppressed while `paradigm shift-based` and `state-of-the-art-system` fire; RULE-D also stops at a hyphen, so `Furthermore-based` is read as a compound modifier and not as the standalone sentence opener the rule names.
